body.condition: The predictable propensity path satisfies \(\max_{i\in I}|m^{-1}\sum_{j\in J}(p_{ij}-E_P[p_{ij}])|=O_P(\sqrt{\log(en)/m})\).

novel.justification: This is an explicit high-level law-side condition used only by the blind-normalization branch.  The core does not derive it from generic mixing or policy-transition conditions: every blind claim is scoped to laws that satisfy the displayed max-row rate, while the displayed Markov witness verifies that rate directly in its proof.
